title: What Happens When You Get Brain Freeze

shots.vo: What happens when you get brain freeze?
shots.caption: What happens when you get **brain freeze?**

shots.vo: When something ice cold hits the roof of your mouth, it chills the blood vessels right behind it.
shots.caption: Ice cold food chills the **roof of your mouth**

shots.vo: Scientists think those blood vessels quickly tighten to hold on to heat.
shots.caption: Blood vessels **tighten** to hold heat

shots.vo: Then they suddenly widen again, and warm blood rushes back in.
shots.caption: Then they suddenly **widen**

shots.vo: A big nerve in your face reports that sudden change as pain, and your brain feels it right in your forehead.
shots.caption: Your brain feels it as **pain in your forehead**

shots.vo: The fix? Press your tongue against the roof of your mouth to warm it back up.
shots.caption: Fix it: press your tongue to the **roof of your mouth**
